title: Vortices behind a cylinder (latticeboltzmann-python)
description: Philip Mocz’s lattice-Boltzmann solver computes flow past a cylinder. Compare locally simulated vorticity at three steps on a 160×64 grid.
description_ko: Philip Mocz의 격자 볼츠만 솔버로 원기둥을 지나는 흐름을 계산했어요. 160×64 격자에서 직접 계산한 세 시간 단계의 와도를 비교하세요.
prompt: Vortices behind a cylinder. Rerun the included recipe to change simulation inputs.
